milestone: W7 first physical webcam acceptance trial — rerun after status-contract fix
objective: Fresh replacement for consumed attempt 001. Same 10-second exact-unit webcam envelope. Only client status parsing changed: successful GET /v1/status no longer requires the POST-only ok field. No new transport, target, timing, retry, reconnect, reclaim, camera, transform, or encoder authority is introduced.

readiness.required_followup: Run scripts/prepare_webcam_w7_rerun_windows.ps1. It rebuilds/stages the corrected runner, reruns adapter/transform/encoder selftests, exercises the corrected C# parser against the real read-only /v1/status endpoint with device_io=false, and freezes the exact new runner hashes. Then review and request fresh exact grant `Grant OPENDITOO-WEBCAM-N980P-002`.

target.pairing_precheck: authenticated exact target; no target override

transport.connection_shape: one connection; one frame in flight; one ACK per frame
transport.one_controller_rule: After a fresh named grant only: stop the MCP product supervisor and verify its session closed; Android Divoom app disconnected. OpenTivoo and port 8779 untouched. Restore MCP separately under its existing Runtime 003 policy after terminal close.

build.source_checkpoint: post-a4871c1 status-contract correction; Windows rebuild/freeze pending
build.identity_note: Attempt 001 exposed a client/Host status schema mismatch before Host open. The correction is limited to accepting the established HTTP-200 status identity document without requiring a POST-style ok field, plus clearer HTTP refusal codes and a read-only real-Host status selftest. Windows rebuild/final hash freeze pending.

session.shape: The Host profile keeps its permanent 40 ms floor. The adapter separately enforces a 90 ms client dispatch cadence and waits for each prior ACK. Keeping these distinct avoids the earlier 83 ms floor/cadence trap and preserves arrival-time margin without changing the Host profile.

stream.source_description: NexiGo VID_0C45 PID_2690 live camera; WinRT Realtime freshest-frame slots; fixed srgb_area transform and deterministic 255-colour guard

live_source.producer_description: Windows-native camera/transform/encoder + typed-session adapter. The exact source and W6-passing Windows Release build are frozen below; Windows-local staging/selftests, nonce negative control and five-minute real-camera soak all passed.

camera.observed_rate_exception: Exposure-quantised 30 fps previously measured; see route section 11. Re-measure in trial preflight, do not promise 60 fps.

transform.palette_guard: closest weighted-colour pair, deterministic scan-order tie break, applied last

live_source.privacy: No saved camera stills or video; metrics only

budgets.derivation: min(floor(10000 / 90) + 1, 500) = 112 frames; 112 * 3 = 336 packets; canonical encoder worst-case is 1054 application bytes including both preambles, so 112 * 1054 = 118048 bytes.

stop_immediately_on: camera missing or no valid first frame before claim/open
Host profile not confirmed as streaming_ack_clock
target, firmware, source or executable hash mismatch
any Host refusal, HTTP/send fault or ACK timeout
malformed or unexpected report / canvas invalidation / stock takeover
10 second lifetime or frame/byte budget reached
stop_policy.on_camera_disconnect: Stop new submissions, allow an already-submitted frame to settle, request close once. Ambiguous close is unknown. Never resend, reconnect or reclaim.
stop_policy.on_host_fault: Terminal unknown; never resend or retry; cleanup must not overwrite unknown.
stop_policy.source_cleanup: Cancel capture/processor and dispose the reader/camera. Collection-continuation flag refers to existing MCP collection, not retaining webcam capture.
stop_policy.recovery: Restore the MCP product separately under Runtime 003 after verifying experiment terminal ownership; do not overlap controllers.

acceptance.transport: bounded clean close; zero retries, reconnects, pacing refusals or encoder-hash mismatches; queue depth at most one
acceptance.visual: owner judges face/hand recognizability and orientation; W2 seven-scene ranking remains outstanding
acceptance.latency: report measured source age and ACK timing separately; do not claim optical latency from an ACK
acceptance.allocation: PASS W6 offline soak: 300.1216216000021 s; growth after warmup 9,416 bytes; 8,647 camera frames captured; transform p95 1.4379999935626984 ms. Real camera + in-memory typed Host only; device_io=false.

persistence_analysis.forbidden: firmware, gallery/persistent uploads, raw send, target selection, command enumeration, pipelining
persistence_analysis.product_policy_effect: none; Runtime 003 is not webcam authority

authority.grant_scope_requested: ONE 10-second live-camera execution to exact Ditoo 11:75:58:CE:DE:C7 v42012 via existing typed Host 127.0.0.1:8796 and streaming_ack_clock profile, 40 ms Host floor plus 90 ms client dispatch cadence, at most 112 frames / 336 packets / 118048 application bytes; one connection and one frame in flight, no retry/reconnect/reclaim; suspend and restore the MCP controller separately. Fresh identity replaces consumed pre-open attempt 001 and remains unauthorized until exact named grant.

adapter.claim_handshake: Runner must produce one fresh valid 16x16 frame and emit camera_ready + nonce before WSL creates the durable one-use claim; only execute:<nonce> may cross the claim boundary.
adapter.deployment_state: status-contract correction source present; corrected Windows runner rebuild/staging and live read-only status selftest pending
